name: Oracle Cloud Always Free Compute
free_limit: Always Free: up to two AMD E2.1.Micro VMs (1/8 OCPU, 1 GB RAM each); Arm Ampere A1: 1,500 OCPU-hours and 9,000 GB-hours/month (equivalent to 2 OCPUs and 12 GB RAM for Always Free tenancies); 200 GB shared boot/block volume storage.
watch_out: Compute must run in the home region; capacity may be unavailable and idle instances may be reclaimed. Payment card required for account verification. Boot volumes use the shared 200 GB allowance; paid account overages can incur charges. Verify tenancy-specific A1 limits.
